notes.title: minor patch 2.0.9
notes.content:
Minor patch 2.0.9

Fixed Yui bugs related to her animation and her one shot killing player when she kick player in the back.
Fixed shrine demon voice keeps repeating too much and now he would talk only when the new information is needed for player.
Added option to mod player model, changes his voice lines and his animations.
Added option to parent mods into existing mods meaning you can now bundle mods together into character mod.

notes.title: path 2.0.8
notes.content:
Added animation changing mod option 
fixed bug with unable to scroll with multiple mods
fixed bugs related with saiko and yui interaction

notes.title: minor patch 2.0.7
notes.content:
Fixed bugs related to mods causing wierd thing
Some yui related issues 
Weapon mods now allow sounds to be changed
Some minor mod change
Some text related changes

Added mod support for changing character model and audio (elissu and yui for now)
Added 2 new languages thailand and phillipines
Fixed couple of bugs related with yui AI 
Fixed some random text related issues 
Fixed some ui related issues.

notes.title: Minor patch 2.0.5
notes.content:
Minor patch 2.0.5
Added 2 new languages French and Italian
Fixed issue with hits not registring when trying to hit enemy with weapon.
Fixed issue with some times yui bugging out when trying to steal the key
Some UI related fixes.
Some minor text related fixes.

notes.title: Update 2.0.3
notes.content:
YUI AI rework 
Now yui has new behaviours and would act differently and uniquely
Player can now call yui on her phone and she can also call player.
Added 2 new languages spanish and turkish.
Added 1 new achivement related to phone and yui new AI behaviour.
Fixed minor bugs related with text.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed issue related with stone and apple some time floating.
Fixed issue with yui coming back to life if clicked on door while she is dead.
Improved combat so the most of the glitches are fixed now.
FIxed issues with russian language.
Fixed issue with head not visible in the shadow.

Additions.
Added korean and chinese language.

notes.title: bug fixes and language addition patch 2.0.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
Fixed issue with music slider not working
Fixed issue with mouse sensitivity slider not saving after changes.
Fixed issue with hungry saiko getting stuck if atempting to take meat from players hand.
Fixed issue with hungry saiko and yui endless stuck together in a loop
Fixed some text overlap issue
Fixed some bunny voices not playing.
Fixed some other minor issues.

Additions:
Added Russian and indonesian language.
Added option to control volume for shrine bunny voice.
Added settings menu for changing volume,music,shrin voice,mouse sensitivity in pause menu.
